properties.displayName: UAV S117 - BLOS SATCOM Autonomy Command Delay/Forge
properties.description: UAVOpmode_CL에서 OpmodeField='blos_autonomy_command'인 SATCOM 경유 자율명령 중 Authorized=0(SByte), 비인가 발신자(Approved_Operators_List 미포함), 또는 ExpectedValue/ObservedValue 불일치(위조 의심)를 탐지. 실제 컬럼: OpmodeField/ExpectedValue/ObservedValue/ChangedBy/Authorized(SByte). MITRE: T0856 Spoof Reporting Message (BLOS 구간에서 자율명령을 지연·위조해 실제 상태와 다른 명령을 주입)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let ApprovedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | project OperatorId;
UAVOpmode_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where OpmodeField == 'blos_autonomy_command'
| extend isUnapproved = ChangedBy !in (ApprovedOps)
| extend isMismatch = ExpectedValue != ObservedValue
| where Authorized == 0 or isUnapproved or isMismatch
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isUnapproved, strcat("BLOS_자율명령_비인가발신자_", ChangedBy),
    isMismatch, strcat("BLOS_자율명령_위조의심_", ExpectedValue, "->", ObservedValue),
    strcat("BLOS_자율명령_비인가_", UAVId))
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, OpmodeField, ExpectedValue, ObservedValue, ChangedBy, Authorized, Seq, TriggerReason
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S117 - BLOS SATCOM Autonomy Command Delay/Forge - {{UAVId}}
